mapper.select: SELECT * FROM address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO address (user_id, contact_name, contact_phone, province, city, district, detail, is_default, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detail}, #{isDefault}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE address SET is_default = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
